OTECH AC/DC Adapter DC 12V 1A (EU Type)

The OTECH AC/DC Adapter DC 12V 1A (EU Type) is a reliable and high-quality power adapter designed for a variety of electronic devices. Whether you need a replacement adapter or an additional power source for your gadgets, this adapter ensures stable and efficient power delivery. This adapter features a universal input voltage range of 100-240V and operates at 50-60Hz, making it suitable for use in different regions. It provides a steady 12V 1A output, delivering 12W of power, which is ideal for powering various low-power electronic devices such as routers, LED strips, CCTV cameras, and small appliances. Equipped with multiple DC plug types, including DC5.52.1mm, 3.51.35mm, and 4.0*1.7mm, the OTECH adapter is designed for compatibility with a wide range of devices. This flexibility makes it a great solution for users who need an adapter that fits multiple electronic applications. Made from high-quality ABS and copper materials, the adapter is both durable and lightweight. The black color adds a sleek and professional look. The EU 2-pin plug design ensures a secure connection for European power outlets, providing convenience for home and office use. The OTECH AC/DC Adapter is built with safety in mind, featuring protection against overvoltage, overcurrent, and short circuits. These safety measures help extend the lifespan of your electronic devices while ensuring stable and efficient operation. Whether for home, office, or travel use, the OTECH AC/DC Adapter DC 12V 1A (EU Type) is a dependable power solution that ensures your devices remain powered with consistent and safe performance.

Features of OTECH AC/DC Adapter DC 12V 1A

  • Universal Compatibility – Supports multiple DC plug types, including DC5.52.1mm, 3.51.35mm, and 4.0*1.7mm, making it compatible with a wide range of electronic devices.
  • Wide Input Voltage Range – Accepts 100-240V, 50-60Hz, making it suitable for international use in various regions.
  • Stable Power Output – Delivers a steady 12V 1A (12W) output, ensuring reliable and efficient power supply for small electronic devices like routers, LED strips, CCTV cameras, and more.
  • Durable Construction – Made from high-quality ABS and copper, offering durability, heat resistance, and long-lasting performance.
  • Compact and Lightweight Design – Easy to carry and store, making it ideal for home, office, or travel use.
  • EU 2-Pin Plug Design – Designed specifically for European power outlets, providing a secure and hassle-free connection.
  • Overvoltage and Short Circuit Protection – Built-in safety features protect connected devices from potential power surges, ensuring a stable and safe power supply.
  •  Energy Efficient – Designed to minimize power consumption and heat generation, promoting efficient operation.
